summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Hoop from Treesh basketball fitness app. All backend APIs working (100% success rate). All frontend pages load correctly with proper routing. All major features tested and working: Courts (address search, map, results), Drills (72 drills, filters, detail dialogs, YouTube videos, fullscreen timer), Plan (tabs, templates, session generator), Dictionary (89 terms, SVG diagrams), Position (body analysis with 5 position results), Games (21 games, HORSE gameplay), Profile (Treesh integration), Form Check (UI rendering), Favorites (export/import). Mobile layout responsive with no overflow. Black-and-pink theme properly applied throughout.
